title: 第677章 南宫九天的自信第676章 我居然服侍过仙师
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
第677章南宫九天的自信
“嗯？这是……”
供奉长老注意到妖物变化，脸色瞬间凝重起来。
只见前方的五只血色怪物，像是一滩滩的液体彼此相融。
直至完全化作一个整体，身上的气息也在急剧攀升，迅速超越超凡巅峰！
甚至在气息上，隐隐有压过前方供奉长老的意思。
并且在这之前，他可还没有听说过，有血色怪物融合变强的事情。
至少在他们这边的情报中，是头一次出现这种情况。
“不好！”
供奉长老神色一变，连忙伸出手来。
顷刻之间，数道金色光刃飞掠而出，向着前方的血色怪物斩去。
只是这一次面对他的攻击，血色怪物怒吼一声，将袭来的金色光刃拍飞出去。
“好家伙，这也变强太多了吧？”
在远处观战的叶云，见此大为惊讶。
而其脑海中的南宫九天，则是沉吟了下说道。
“以它现在的实力，你们圣地那个长老只怕是解决不了了。”
正如她所说的一样，这供奉长老修为在筑道三重的样子。
可融为一体的血色怪物，却是拥有筑道四五重的气息。
再加上那极强的肉身素质，以及逆天的恢复力，可谓是极具压迫感了。
对此，叶云不忘提了一句。

“我说前辈，您约定的事情，自己可别忘了。”
南宫九天轻哼一声，没好气道。
“知道了，本座还能骗你？”
叶云提到的约定，自然就是对方出手之事。
虽然以他的战力，足以将这血色怪物给抹杀。
但想要将其活捉，就像上次翡青珞一样，却是有点难度过高了。
而就在他们交谈之际，另一边的战场，则已经骤然扭转。
融为一体的血色怪物，凭借着强横的肉身力量，硬是将供奉长老给压制了。
面对供奉长老接连祭出的剑诀，法宝，血色怪物都直接选择硬抗！
任凭那剑诀与法宝，将其身体撕开，但转眼间又重新愈合了。
并且趁此机会，反过来对供奉长老发起攻击！
放在正常修士身上，简直就是以命换伤的打法，伤敌一千自损一万。
可在拥有逆天恢复力的血色怪物身上，反而成了近乎无解的战斗手段。
“该死，再这么下去要出事了。”
眼看局势越发危急，供奉长老看了眼附近，正在迅速疏散的小镇居民。
若是自己不多撑一段时间，恐怕这附近之人，大多都要遭殃遇难。
面前的血色怪物，却是节节逼近，压迫感拉满了。
“可恶，就是燃烧精血也要……”
content_en:
Chapter 677 Nangong Jiutian’s Confidence
"Huh? This is..."
The worshiping elder noticed the changes in the monster, and his expression instantly became serious.
I saw five bloody monsters in front of me, like pools of liquid melting into each other.
Until it is completely transformed into a whole body, the aura on the body is also rising sharply, quickly surpassing the extraordinary peak!
Even in the breath, there is a faint meaning that it overpowers the elders worshiping in front.
And before this, he had never heard of the bloody monster merging and becoming stronger.
At least in their intelligence, this is the first time this has happened.
"Not good!"
The expression of the worshiping elder changed and he quickly stretched out his hand.
In an instant, several golden light blades flew out and slashed towards the bloody monster in front.
Only this time, facing his attack, the bloody monster roared and flew away the incoming golden light blade.
"Good guy, isn't this too powerful?"
Ye Yun, who was watching the battle from a distance, was greatly surprised when he saw this.
Nangong Jiutian in his mind pondered for a moment and said.
"With its current strength, the elder of your Holy Land may not be able to solve it."
Just as she said, the elder's cultivation seems to be at the third level of Taoism.
The blood-colored monster that can be integrated into one body has the aura of the fourth and fifth levels of Taoism.
Coupled with the extremely strong physical quality and the incredible resilience, it can be said to be extremely oppressive.
Ye Yun did not forget to mention this.
"Senior, don't forget what you agreed on."
Nangong Jiutian snorted softly and said unhappily.
"I know, can I still lie to you?"
The agreement that Ye Yun mentioned was naturally a matter for the other party to take action.
Although his fighting power is enough to obliterate this bloody monster.
But it is a bit too difficult to capture it alive, just like Feiqingluo last time.
While they were talking, the battlefield on the other side had suddenly changed.
The fused bloody monster relied on its tyrannical physical strength to suppress the enshrined elder.
Facing the sword arts, magic weapons, and bloody monsters that the enshrined elders offered one after another, they all chose to resist!
The sword technique and magic weapon tore his body apart, but it healed up again in the blink of an eye.
And took this opportunity to attack the enshrined elder!
Put it on a normal monk, it is simply a strategy of exchanging lives for injuries, injuring the enemy by 1,000 and damaging yourself by 10,000.
But for the bloody monster with incredible resilience, it has become an almost insurmountable means of fighting.
"Damn it, something's going to happen if you keep going like this."
Seeing that the situation was becoming more and more critical, the worshiping elder glanced at the residents of the nearby town who were quickly evacuating.
If I don't hold on for a while, I'm afraid most of the people nearby will suffer disaster.
The bloody monster in front of him was getting closer and closer, creating a sense of oppression.
"Damn it, even if you burn the essence and blood..."
